objective: Exact expected network.v2 weighted-random-failure trapezoidal AUC; no targeted component
selection: Highest mean exact deployment AUC over 16 development cases; canonical policy JSON breaks exact ties
primaryContrast: Selected policy versus random-start hill climbing, paired over heldout environment seeds and averaged across the two primary regimes per seed
baselines: 64-evaluation random-start simulated annealing with geometric temperature 0.005 to 0.00005
success: Primary paired mean difference exceeds 0.005 and its paired bootstrap 95% lower limit exceeds zero; selected policy also exceeds the best fixed heuristic in mean. Report every regime and transfer contrast regardless of outcome.
accounting: Every scored proposal including duplicate graphs and failed mutation attempts consumes one of 64 evaluations. Retain all 48 proposed policies and their development scores. Report offline training evaluations separately; zero-search generator uses no objective feedback, with one evaluation only to measure its output.
freeze: This protocol is written before development or heldout execution. After development, freeze policy, source hashes and selection before evaluating any heldout environment. No holdout-informed tuning within this experiment.
scope: Credential-free parameter evolution only; no LLM inference, no claim of token efficiency, global optimality, or algorithm novelty. Random graph baseline is the repository's shuffled recursive tree plus extra edges, not a uniform connected-graph distribution.
